production.text:
Delete a run
Copy page

Delete a stored Agent run.

DELETE
/
agent
/
runs
/
{id}
Try it
Deleting a run removes the stored run from your team’s Agent run history.
Get your Exa API key
Create a key in the dashboard. New accounts start with free credits.
Authorizations
apiKey
bearer
apiKey
​
x-api-key
stringheaderrequired

Pass your Exa API key in the x-api-key header. You can also authenticate with Authorization: Bearer .

Path Parameters
​
id
stringrequired

Agent run ID.

Required string length: 1 - 200
Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]+$
Example:

"agent_run_01j7x9v0m2n4p6q8r0s2t4v6w8"

Response
200
application/json

Agent run deleted

​
id
stringrequired

Agent run ID. New run IDs are returned with the agent_run_ prefix.

Required string length: 1 - 200
Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]+$
Example:

"agent_run_01j7x9v0m2n4p6q8r0s2t4v6w8"

​
object
stringrequired
Allowed value: "agent_run.deleted"
​
deleted
booleanrequired
